WITH RECURSIVE vals(value, rest) AS (
  SELECT '', COALESCE(subtypes, '') || CASE WHEN subtypes IS NOT NULL AND supertypes IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END || COALESCE(supertypes, '') || ','
  FROM cards
  WHERE instr(',' || COALESCE(availability, '') || ',', ',arena,') > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)), substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
  FROM vals
  WHERE instr(rest, ',') > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT value AS type
FROM vals
WHERE value <> ''
ORDER BY type;

WITH yearly_sets AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS year, COUNT(*) AS set_count
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', releaseDate)

  SELECT language
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY language
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

       (SELECT language FROM common_language) AS common_language;

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(banned_count) AS banned_count
  FROM banned_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT bc.format, c.name
FROM banned_counts AS bc
